title: Love & Healthy Relationships
intro: This is the age of sharing, hitting, hugging and apologising, often within the same minute. It is where kindness is first practised rather than admired. This month gives a child the simplest possible words for love, and gives their parents the harder job of showing it while exhausted.

keyScriptures.text: Love is patient, love is kind.
Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other.

weeks.title: Kind Hands
weeks.declaration: Your hands are for helping, not hurting. You are learning that, and you will get there.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, make our hands gentle so our child learns gentleness from them. Amen.

weeks.title: Sharing Is Not Losing
weeks.declaration: When you share, you do not lose. There is enough here, and there always will be.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, take the fear out of sharing for our child. Let them feel how much there is. Amen.

weeks.title: Sorry and Sorted
weeks.declaration: When you get it wrong you can say sorry, and then it is sorted. That is how this family works.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, let us say sorry too, out loud, so our child knows how. Amen.

weeks.title: Everyone Is Included
weeks.declaration: Look for the person who is on their own, and go to them. That is one of the best things a person can do.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, give our child eyes for whoever is left out. Amen.

days.title: Kind Hands
days.declaration: Your hands are for helping, not for hurting. You are still learning, and that is fine.

scripture.text: Be kind and compassionate to one another.

days.title: Gentle Words
days.declaration: Gentle words make people feel better. Loud angry words make them feel worse.

scripture.text: A gentle answer turns away wrath.

days.title: Sharing Is Not Losing
days.declaration: When you share, you do not lose. There is enough for everyone here.

scripture.text: It is more blessed to give than to receive.

days.title: Saying Sorry
days.declaration: When you get it wrong, you can say sorry. Then it is sorted.

scripture.text: Confess your sins to each other.

days.title: Forgiving
days.declaration: When someone says sorry to you, you can let it go. That is called forgiving.

scripture.text: Forgive as the Lord forgave you.

days.title: Taking Turns
days.declaration: Waiting for your turn is hard. Doing hard things makes you stronger.

scripture.text: Love is patient, love is kind.

days.title: Helping
days.declaration: Helping someone is one of the best things you can do all day.

scripture.text: Serve one another humbly in love.

days.title: Being Left Out Hurts
days.declaration: It hurts to be left out. So look for whoever is on their own and go to them.

scripture.text: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves.

days.title: Love Waits
days.declaration: Love waits for people. It does not rush them or give up on them.

scripture.text: Love is patient.

days.title: Not Grabbing
days.declaration: You do not have to grab. You can ask, and asking usually works better.

scripture.text: You do not have because you do not ask.

days.title: Big Feelings, Kind Hands
days.declaration: You can feel very angry and still be gentle. Feelings and hands are different things.

scripture.text: In your anger do not sin.

days.title: Everyone Gets Some
days.declaration: There is enough for everyone. Nobody has to go without so you can have more.

scripture.text: My God will meet all your needs.

days.title: Saying Thank You
days.declaration: Thank you is a small thing that makes people glad. Say it often.

scripture.text: Give thanks in all circumstances.

days.title: Being a Friend
days.declaration: A good friend shares, waits and comes back. You can be one of those.

scripture.text: A friend loves at all times.

days.title: Loved When You Hit
days.declaration: When you hurt someone, you are still loved. But we will help you stop.

scripture.text: No discipline seems pleasant at the time.

days.title: Hugs Are Good
days.declaration: Hugs from safe people are good. You can always ask for one.

scripture.text: He took the children in his arms and blessed them.

days.title: Your Voice Matters
days.declaration: If you do not like something, you can say so with your words.

scripture.text: How good is a timely word!

days.title: Kind to Small Things
days.declaration: Be gentle with animals, babies and little things. Strong people are gentle.

scripture.text: The righteous care for the needs of their animals.

days.title: Not Everyone Is Nice
days.declaration: Some people will not be kind to you. That is about them, not about you.

scripture.text: Though my father and mother forsake me, the Lord will receive me.

days.title: Telling a Grown-Up
days.declaration: If someone is unkind or scary, tell a grown-up you trust. That is the right thing.

scripture.text: If either of them falls down, one can help the other up.

days.title: Playing Together
days.declaration: Playing with someone is better than playing alone, most of the time.

scripture.text: Two are better than one.

days.title: Not Keeping Score
days.declaration: You do not have to remember who did what. You can just start again.

scripture.text: Love keeps no record of wrongs.

days.title: Loving Your Family
days.declaration: The people in your house are the first people you get to love. Start here.

scripture.text: Honour your father and your mother.

days.title: Being Glad for Someone
days.declaration: When someone else gets a turn, you can be glad for them. Try it.

scripture.text: Rejoice with those who rejoice.

days.title: Kind When Nobody Sees
days.declaration: Being kind when nobody is looking is the best kind of kind.

scripture.text: Do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing.

days.title: Words Can Hurt
days.declaration: Words can hurt more than hands. Choose them carefully.

scripture.text: The tongue has the power of life and death.

days.title: Coming Back After a Fight
days.declaration: After a fight, you can come back. Nothing is broken forever here.

scripture.text: Go and point out their fault, just between the two of you.

days.title: Loving God
days.declaration: You can love God back. Talking to Him is a good way to start.

scripture.text: Love the Lord your God with all your heart.

days.title: Making Room
days.declaration: There is always room for one more. Make some.

scripture.text: Practise hospitality.

days.title: Love Is Strong
days.declaration: Love is not soft or weak. It is the strongest thing there is.

scripture.text: Love never fails.

days.title: Practise Again Tomorrow
days.declaration: You will practise all this again tomorrow. Nobody gets it right first time.

scripture.text: I press on toward the goal.
